modelEfficacy.reason: This bench measures deterministic kernel routes, receipts, and gates; no provider was called.

mechanisms.claim: A deterministic lexical route can return an exact source-bound page.
mechanisms.bench: self-hit and polarity probes recorded source sequence routes
mechanisms.notClaimed: This does not establish semantic retrieval or model answer quality.

mechanisms.claim: Compiled packets carry a kernel reachability receipt when present.
mechanisms.bench: natural probes record receipt presence; Phase 1 closure oracles own completeness
mechanisms.notClaimed: This bench does not prove four-state closure for every retained byte.

mechanisms.claim: Collection cues expose located/support counts without inventing cardinality.
mechanisms.bench: known-cardinality incomplete and unknown-cardinality not-established probes
mechanisms.notClaimed: Coverage is a route lower bound, not proof that the world contains only those items.

mechanisms.claim: Kernel scanning and witness-bound capabilities classify remembered assertions.
mechanisms.bench: omitted-map UNKNOWN, exact witnessed SUPPORTED, world, and reasoning controls
mechanisms.notClaimed: The gate does not certify unsupported model prose or general reasoning.

mechanisms.claim: A ready semantic address is counted only when it returns an exact target sequence.
mechanisms.bench: 6/13 ready-runtime probes returned exact target sequences; all counted hits were exact, while non-target pages remain in the false-page metric
mechanisms.notClaimed: These authored probes do not estimate semantic recall, precision, or ranking quality.

mechanisms.claim: A packaged sqlite-vec and pinned embedding runtime is available to produce semantic addresses.
mechanisms.bench: 13/13 probes returned ready receipts bound to the pinned model digest; the runtime is packages/core/src/semantic-runtime.ts, exercised by kernel tests, and this compile-only bench invokes no semantic runtime directly
mechanisms.notClaimed: Receipt availability is not proof of semantic efficacy, and this bench exercises no semantic runtime of its own; no semantic efficacy claim is made.

mechanisms.claim: Successful grounded turns can be reused through persisted routes.
mechanisms.bench: not exercised by this compile-only bench; see the external address monotonicity oracle
mechanisms.notClaimed: This bench does not establish route reuse, invalidation, or semantic authority.

mechanisms.claim: A model answers natural questions accurately.
mechanisms.notClaimed: No provider was called, so no model efficacy claim is made.
